examples.japanese: {部長|ぶちょう}に{昇進|しょうしん}した。
examples.english: I was promoted to department manager.

examples.japanese: {昇進|しょうしん}おめでとうございます。
{昇進|しょうしん}すると{責任|せきにん}も{重|おも}くなる。

notes:
{昇進|しょうしん} means being promoted to a higher position or rank at work. As a suru-verb, it means "to be promoted", "to advance in rank".

Related terms:
- {昇給|しょうきゅう} (salary increase)
- {降格|こうかく} (demotion) - antonym
- {出世|しゅっせ} (career advancement, getting ahead)

Common expressions:
- 〜に{昇進|しょうしん}する (be promoted to ~)
- {昇進|しょうしん}を{目指|めざ}す (aim for promotion)
- {昇進|しょうしん}{試験|しけん} (promotion exam)
